title: BirdNET-Go Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the BirdNET-Go plugin - polls the BirdNET-Go REST API to display the most recent bird and today's detection stats on the LED matrix

enabled.description: Enable or disable the BirdNET-Go plugin

update_interval.description: How often (seconds) to run background update tasks (image warmup, connection health)

mqtt.description: Optional. Only needed for sub-second interrupt pop-ups - the REST API alone drives both screens.

enabled.description: Subscribe to an MQTT broker for pushed detections. Leave off to rely on REST polling alone.

host.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP address

topic.description: MQTT topic BirdNET-Go publishes detections to. Supports wildcards (+ and #).

birdnet_api.description: The primary data source: detections, daily stats and species images all come from here.

base_url.description: Base URL of the BirdNET-Go web server, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8084

request_timeout.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for API requests

poll_interval.description: How often (seconds) to poll for new detections and refresh daily stats

mode.description: rotation: always shows most recent bird during plugin's rotation slot. interrupt: pops up only on new detections. both: rotation slot plus interrupt on new detections.

interrupt_duration.description: Seconds to show a pop-up detection in interrupt mode

rotation_duration.description: Seconds to show the bird during the plugin's rotation slot

min_confidence.description: Ignore detections with confidence below this threshold (0.0-1.0)

stale_after_minutes.description: If no detection arrives within this many minutes, show a 'no recent detection' frame instead

show_image.description: Fetch and display the species image

show_time.description: Show how long ago the bird was detected

unique_species.description: Show a different species each rotation slot instead of repeating whatever called last. On a busy feed one or two loud species would otherwise fill nearly every slot.

max_species.description: How many of today's species to cycle through

species_order.description: recent: most recently heard species first. frequency: most-heard species first.

show_today_count.description: Show how many times the species has been heard today (e.g. x203)

stats.description: The birdnet_stats screen: today's species count, total detections and most-heard species.

enabled.description: Show the stats screen. When off, the plugin's stats rotation slot is skipped.

top_n.description: How many of the most-heard species to keep. The panel shows as many as fit.

rotation_duration.description: Seconds to show the stats screen during its rotation slot

font_path.description: Path to font file (TTF). Relative to project root or absolute path.

accent_color.description: RGB accent color [R, G, B] for the stats header and per-species counts

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second for long bird names

scroll_gap_width.description: Gap width in pixels between scroll loops

field_mapping.description: Override BirdNET-Go payload field names if your version uses different keys. Matching is case-insensitive with common variants tried automatically.
